parameters.name: AuthorizationId
parameters.description:
The ID of the project authorization to query.
> You can call the ListProjectAuthorizations operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
